formula_a.ranking: At request time, use official latest actual ordering; include already completed matches that day; exclude live matches; never override official order with homemade tiebreak.
formula_a.ranking_context: Use the current match competition standings when that competition has a standings table. Domestic league matches use domestic league official table.
formula_a.fixtures: Previous 3 actual first-team matches + current match + next 2 confirmed first-team matches, true chronological order, ALL competitions, including confirmed club friendlies.
formula_a.stats_scope: Form, Avg Goal Scored and Avg Goal Conceded are calculated ONLY in the analyzed match's competition. If no sample exists, keep blank.
formula_a.days: Rest Days = later match calendar date - earlier match calendar date - 1 after converting schedules to America/New_York.

formula_b.ranking: Use latest official UCL total table at request time.
formula_b.header: UCL points to the left of team name; domestic league name to the right.

fatigue.Not Tired: previous match to current >=4 rest days
fatigue.Tired: previous match to current <=3 rest days
fatigue.Very Tired: previous match to current <=3 AND second previous to previous <=3

formula_b.next3: Next 3 confirmed first-team matches after current, all competitions, ET.
formula_b.ucl_fixtures: Full 8 UCL league-phase fixtures; played fixtures include scores.
formula_b.ucl_table: Complete current UCL total table on same worksheet right side, plus Form/WDL when available.
formula_b.intent: Leave intent blank unless explicitly requested.

formula_c.ranking: Use analyzed competition latest official table if independent table exists; otherwise domestic official table.
formula_c.next3: Next 3 confirmed first-team matches after current across all competitions including confirmed club friendlies.
formula_c.must_win: Only actual necessity supported by competition mathematics/qualification/title/relegation/knockout situation.
formula_c.want_win: Requires clear evidence of both motivation and realistic ability/conditions to beat opponent. Strength tier alone never enough.
formula_c.hope_win: Positive win preference but evidence not strong enough for Want Win.
formula_c.dont_lose_gate: Only candidate after old factors lean Don't Lose AND (next opponent is 优 OR both next two opponents are each two strength levels above this team). Current strong opponent alone is insufficient.
formula_c.same_strength: Same/close strength and no clear basis => ---.
